capabilities: Track Markdown note count, body count, tags, and internal links
Display growth trends with trend cards and charts in a dashboard
Show a compact mini panel in the right sidebar
Backfill historical growth from existing vault file metadata
disambiguation: Not a learning or memory-improvement tool; despite the name, it only measures vault statistics and their growth over time.
extras: Runs entirely locally; the README states it sends no vault data to remote services, has no telemetry, and needs no account.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to see how the vault's size and content grow over time.
summary: Vault statistics plugin that tracks note, tag, and link counts with daily snapshots, trend charts, a dashboard, and a sidebar mini panel.
